transport_policy: Parts are continuations. Missing catalog entries are not negative evidence.

obligations_to_time.requirement: A later fuzz invocation with valid audio input must be able to reach encoding after an earlier invocation requested the version.
obligations_to_time.target_route: A first input supplies -v; parse_option sets show_version. A second input supplies a valid WAVE file without -v. The entry resets getopt state, but init_options does not reset show_version, so do_it returns before encode_file.
obligations_to_time.failure_condition: After the first invocation, every later invocation in the same process takes the version return, leaving supported encoding unreachable.

71|/* Exact Rice codeword length calculation is off by default.  The simple
72| * (and fast) estimation (of how many bits a residual value will be
73| * encoded with) in this encoder is very good, almost always yielding
74| * compression within 0.1% of exact calculation.
75| */

77|/* Rice parameter searching is off by default.  The simple (and fast)
78| * parameter estimation in this encoder is very good, almost always
79| * yielding compression within 0.1% of the optimal parameters.
80| */
81|#undef ENABLE_RICE_PARAMETER_SEARCH

3863|				encoder->protected_->state = FLAC__STREAM_ENCODER_FRAMING_ERROR;

4176|
4177|	{
4178|		int partition_order;
4179|		uint32_t sum;
4180|
4181|		for(partition_order = (int)max_partition_order, sum = 0; partition_order >= (int)min_partition_order; partition_order--) {
4182|			if(!
4183|				set_partitioned_rice_(
4184|#ifdef EXACT_RICE_BITS_CALCULATION
4185|					residual,
4186|#endif
4187|					abs_residual_partition_sums+sum,
4188|					raw_bits_per_partition+sum,
4189|					residual_samples,
4190|					predictor_order,
4191|					rice_parameter_limit,

4193|					(uint32_t)partition_order,
4194|					do_escape_coding,
4195|					&private_->partitioned_rice_contents_extra[!best_parameters_index],

4202|			}

4205|				best_residual_bits = residual_bits;
4206|				best_parameters_index = !best_parameters_index;
4207|				best_partition_order = partition_order;
4208|			}
4209|		}
4210|	}
4211|
4212|	best_ecm->data.partitioned_rice.order = best_partition_order;
4213|
4214|	{
4215|		/*
4216|		 * We are allowed to de-const the pointer based on our special
4217|		 * knowledge; it is const to the outside world.
4218|		 */
4219|		FLAC__EntropyCodingMethod_PartitionedRiceContents* prc = (FLAC__EntropyCodingMethod_PartitionedRiceContents*)best_ecm->data.partitioned_rice.contents;
4220|		uint32_t partition;
4221|
4222|		/* save best parameters and raw_bits */
4223|		memcpy(prc->parameters, private_->partitioned_rice_contents_extra[best_parameters_index].parameters, (uint32_t)sizeof(uint32_t)*(1<<(best_partition_order)));
4224|		if(do_escape_coding)

4242|void precompute_partition_info_sums_(
4243|	const FLAC__int32 residual[],
4244|	FLAC__uint64 abs_residual_partition_sums[],
4245|	uint32_t residual_samples,
4246|	uint32_t predictor_order,
4247|	uint32_t min_partition_order,
4248|	uint32_t max_partition_order,
4249|	uint32_t bps
4250|)
4251|{
4252|	const uint32_t default_partition_samples = (residual_samples + predictor_order) >> max_partition_order;
4253|	uint32_t partitions = 1u << max_partition_order;
4254|
4255|	FLAC__ASSERT(default_partition_samples > predictor_order);
4256|
4257|	/* first do max_partition_order */
4258|	{
4259|		const uint32_t threshold = 32 - FLAC__bitmath_ilog2(default_partition_samples);
4260|		uint32_t partition, residual_sample, end = (uint32_t)(-(int)predictor_order);
4261|		/* WATCHOUT: "bps + FLAC__MAX_EXTRA_RESIDUAL_BPS" is the maximum assumed size of the average residual magnitude */
4262|		if(bps + FLAC__MAX_EXTRA_RESIDUAL_BPS < threshold) {
4263|			for(partition = residual_sample = 0; partition < partitions; partition++) {
4264|				FLAC__uint32 abs_residual_partition_sum = 0;
4265|				end += default_partition_samples;
4266|				for( ; residual_sample < end; residual_sample++)
4267|					abs_residual_partition_sum += abs(residual[residual_sample]); /* abs(INT_MIN) is undefined, but if the residual is INT_MIN we have bigger problems */
4268|				abs_residual_partition_sums[partition] = abs_residual_partition_sum;
4269|			}
4270|		}
4271|		else { /* have to pessimistically use 64 bits for accumulator */
4272|			for(partition = residual_sample = 0; partition < partitions; partition++) {
4273|				FLAC__uint64 abs_residual_partition_sum64 = 0;
4274|				end += default_partition_samples;
4275|				for( ; residual_sample < end; residual_sample++)
4276|					abs_residual_partition_sum64 += abs(residual[residual_sample]); /* abs(INT_MIN) is undefined, but if the residual is INT_MIN we have bigger problems */
4277|				abs_residual_partition_sums[partition] = abs_residual_partition_sum64;
4278|			}
4279|		}
4280|	}
4281|
4282|	/* now merge partitions for lower orders */
4283|	{
4284|		uint32_t from_partition = 0, to_partition = partitions;
4285|		int partition_order;
4286|		for(partition_order = (int)max_partition_order - 1; partition_order >= (int)min_partition_order; partition_order--) {
4287|			uint32_t i;
4288|			partitions >>= 1;
4289|			for(i = 0; i < partitions; i++) {
4290|				abs_residual_partition_sums[to_partition++] =
4291|					abs_residual_partition_sums[from_partition  ] +
4292|					abs_residual_partition_sums[from_partition+1];
4293|				from_partition += 2;
4294|			}
4295|		}
4296|	}
4297|}

4299|void precompute_partition_info_escapes_(
4300|	const FLAC__int32 residual[],
4301|	uint32_t raw_bits_per_partition[],
4302|	uint32_t residual_samples,
4303|	uint32_t predictor_order,
4304|	uint32_t min_partition_order,
4305|	uint32_t max_partition_order
4306|)
4307|{
4308|	int partition_order;
4309|	uint32_t from_partition, to_partition = 0;
4310|	const uint32_t blocksize = residual_samples + predictor_order;
4311|
4312|	/* first do max_partition_order */
4313|	for(partition_order = (int)max_partition_order; partition_order >= 0; partition_order--) {
4314|		FLAC__int32 r;
4315|		FLAC__uint32 rmax;
4316|		uint32_t partition, partition_sample, partition_samples, residual_sample;
4317|		const uint32_t partitions = 1u << partition_order;
4318|		const uint32_t default_partition_samples = blocksize >> partition_order;
4319|
4320|		FLAC__ASSERT(default_partition_samples > predictor_order);
4321|
4322|		for(partition = residual_sample = 0; partition < partitions; partition++) {
4323|			partition_samples = default_partition_samples;
4324|			if(partition == 0)
4325|				partition_samples -= predictor_order;
4326|			rmax = 0;
4327|			for(partition_sample = 0; partition_sample < partition_samples; partition_sample++) {
4328|				r = residual[residual_sample++];
4329|				/* OPT: maybe faster: rmax |= r ^ (r>>31) */
4330|				if(r < 0)
4331|					rmax |= ~r;
4332|				else
4333|					rmax |= r;
4334|			}
4335|			/* now we know all residual values are in the range [-rmax-1,rmax] */
4336|			raw_bits_per_partition[partition] = rmax? FLAC__bitmath_ilog2(rmax) + 2 : 1;
4337|		}
4338|		to_partition = partitions;
4339|		break; /*@@@ yuck, should remove the 'for' loop instead */
4340|	}
4341|
4342|	/* now merge partitions for lower orders */
4343|	for(from_partition = 0, --partition_order; partition_order >= (int)min_partition_order; partition_order--) {
4344|		uint32_t m;
4345|		uint32_t i;
4346|		const uint32_t partitions = 1u << partition_order;
4347|		for(i = 0; i < partitions; i++) {
4348|			m = raw_bits_per_partition[from_partition];
4349|			from_partition++;
4350|			raw_bits_per_partition[to_partition] = flac_max(m, raw_bits_per_partition[from_partition]);
4351|			from_partition++;
4352|			to_partition++;
4353|		}
4354|	}

4399|FLAC__bool set_partitioned_rice_(
4400|#ifdef EXACT_RICE_BITS_CALCULATION
4401|	const FLAC__int32 residual[],
4402|#endif
4403|	const FLAC__uint64 abs_residual_partition_sums[],
4404|	const uint32_t raw_bits_per_partition[],
4405|	const uint32_t residual_samples,
4406|	const uint32_t predictor_order,
4407|	const uint32_t rice_parameter_limit,
4408|	const uint32_t rice_parameter_search_dist,
4409|	const uint32_t partition_order,
4410|	const FLAC__bool search_for_escapes,
4411|	FLAC__EntropyCodingMethod_PartitionedRiceContents *partitioned_rice_contents,
4412|	uint32_t *bits
4413|)
4414|{
4415|	uint32_t rice_parameter, partition_bits;
4416|	uint32_t best_partition_bits, best_rice_parameter = 0;
4417|	uint32_t bits_ = FLAC__ENTROPY_CODING_METHOD_TYPE_LEN + FLAC__ENTROPY_CODING_METHOD_PARTITIONED_RICE_ORDER_LEN;
4418|	uint32_t *parameters, *raw_bits;
4419|	uint32_t partition, residual_sample;
4420|	uint32_t partition_samples, partition_samples_base;
4421|	uint32_t partition_samples_fixed_point_divisor, partition_samples_fixed_point_divisor_base;
4422|	const uint32_t partitions = 1u << partition_order;
4423|	FLAC__uint64 mean;
4424|#ifdef ENABLE_RICE_PARAMETER_SEARCH
4425|	uint32_t min_rice_parameter, max_rice_parameter;
4426|#else
4427|	(void)rice_parameter_search_dist;
4428|#endif
4429|
4430|	FLAC__ASSERT(rice_parameter_limit <= FLAC__ENTROPY_CODING_METHOD_PARTITIONED_RICE2_ESCAPE_PARAMETER);
4431|
4432|	parameters = partitioned_rice_contents->parameters;
4433|	raw_bits = partitioned_rice_contents->raw_bits;
4434|
4435|	partition_samples_base = (residual_samples+predictor_order) >> partition_order;
4436|
4437|	/* Integer division is slow. To speed up things, precalculate a fixed point
4438|	 * divisor, as all partitions except the first are the same size. 18 bits
4439|	 * are taken because maximum block size is 65535, max partition size for
4440|	 * partitions other than 0 is 32767 (15 bit), max abs residual is 2^31,
4441|	 * which leaves 18 bit */
4442|	partition_samples_fixed_point_divisor_base = 0x40000 / partition_samples_base;
4443|
4444|	for(partition = residual_sample = 0; partition < partitions; partition++) {
4445|		partition_samples = partition_samples_base;
4446|		if(partition > 0) {
4447|			partition_samples_fixed_point_divisor = partition_samples_fixed_point_divisor_base;
4448|		}
4449|		else {
4450|			if(partition_samples <= predictor_order)
4451|				return false;
4452|			else
4453|				partition_samples -= predictor_order;
4454|			partition_samples_fixed_point_divisor = 0x40000 / partition_samples;
4455|		}
4456|		mean = abs_residual_partition_sums[partition];
4457|		/* 'mean' is not a good name for the variable, it is
4458|		 * actually the sum of magnitudes of all residual values
4459|		 * in the partition, so the actual mean is
4460|		 * mean/partition_samples
4461|		 */
4462|		if(mean < 2 || (((mean - 1)*partition_samples_fixed_point_divisor)>>18) == 0)
4463|			rice_parameter = 0;
4464|		else
4465|			rice_parameter = FLAC__bitmath_ilog2_wide(((mean - 1)*partition_samples_fixed_point_divisor)>>18) + 1;
4466|
4467|		if(rice_parameter >= rice_parameter_limit) {
4468|#ifndef NDEBUG
4469|			fprintf(stderr, "clipping rice_parameter (%u -> %u) @6\n", rice_parameter, rice_parameter_limit - 1);
4470|#endif
4471|			rice_parameter = rice_parameter_limit - 1;
4472|		}
4473|
4474|		best_partition_bits = UINT32_MAX;
4475|#ifdef ENABLE_RICE_PARAMETER_SEARCH
4476|		if(rice_parameter_search_dist) {
4477|			if(rice_parameter < rice_parameter_search_dist)
4478|				min_rice_parameter = 0;
4479|			else
4480|				min_rice_parameter = rice_parameter - rice_parameter_search_dist;
4481|			max_rice_parameter = rice_parameter + rice_parameter_search_dist;
4482|			if(max_rice_parameter >= rice_parameter_limit) {
4483|#ifndef NDEBUG
4484|				fprintf(stderr, "clipping rice_parameter (%u -> %u) @7\n", max_rice_parameter, rice_parameter_limit - 1);
4485|#endif
4486|				max_rice_parameter = rice_parameter_limit - 1;
4487|			}
4488|		}
4489|		else
4490|			min_rice_parameter = max_rice_parameter = rice_parameter;
4491|
4492|		for(rice_parameter = min_rice_parameter; rice_parameter <= max_rice_parameter; rice_parameter++) {
4493|#endif
4494|#ifdef EXACT_RICE_BITS_CALCULATION
4495|			partition_bits = count_rice_bits_in_partition_(rice_parameter, partition_samples, residual+residual_sample);
4496|#else
4497|			partition_bits = count_rice_bits_in_partition_(rice_parameter, partition_samples, abs_residual_partition_sums[partition]);
4498|#endif
4499|			if(partition_bits < best_partition_bits) {
4500|				best_rice_parameter = rice_parameter;
4501|				best_partition_bits = partition_bits;
4502|			}
4503|#ifdef ENABLE_RICE_PARAMETER_SEARCH
4504|		}
4505|#endif
4506|		if(search_for_escapes) {
4507|			partition_bits = FLAC__ENTROPY_CODING_METHOD_PARTITIONED_RICE2_PARAMETER_LEN + FLAC__ENTROPY_CODING_METHOD_PARTITIONED_RICE_RAW_LEN + raw_bits_per_partition[partition] * partition_samples;
4508|			if(partition_bits <= best_partition_bits && raw_bits_per_partition[partition] < 32) {
4509|				raw_bits[partition] = raw_bits_per_partition[partition];
4510|				best_rice_parameter = 0; /* will be converted to appropriate escape parameter later */
4511|				best_partition_bits = partition_bits;
4512|			}
4513|			else
4514|				raw_bits[partition] = 0;
4515|		}
4516|		parameters[partition] = best_rice_parameter;
4517|		if(best_partition_bits < UINT32_MAX - bits_) // To make sure _bits doesn't overflow
4518|			bits_ += best_partition_bits;
4519|		else
4520|			bits_ = UINT32_MAX;

4522|	}

4528|uint32_t get_wasted_bits_(FLAC__int32 signal[], uint32_t samples)
4529|{
4530|	uint32_t i, shift;
4531|	FLAC__int32 x = 0;
4532|
4533|	for(i = 0; i < samples && !(x&1); i++)
4534|		x |= signal[i];
4535|
4536|	if(x == 0) {
4537|		shift = 0;
4538|	}
4539|	else {
4540|		for(shift = 0; !(x&1); shift++)
4541|			x >>= 1;
4542|	}
4543|
4544|	if(shift > 0) {
4545|		for(i = 0; i < samples; i++)
4546|			 signal[i] >>= shift;
4547|	}
4548|
4549|	return shift;
4550|}

4552|uint32_t get_wasted_bits_wide_(FLAC__int64 signal_wide[], FLAC__int32 signal[], uint32_t samples)
4553|{
4554|	uint32_t i, shift;
4555|	FLAC__int64 x = 0;
4556|
4557|	for(i = 0; i < samples && !(x&1); i++)
4558|		x |= signal_wide[i];
4559|
4560|	if(x == 0) {
4561|		shift = 1;
4562|	}
4563|	else {
4564|		for(shift = 0; !(x&1); shift++)
4565|			x >>= 1;
4566|	}
4567|
4568|	if(shift > 0) {
4569|		for(i = 0; i < samples; i++)
4570|			 signal[i] = (FLAC__int32)(signal_wide[i] >> shift);
4571|	}
4572|
4573|	return shift;

4606|FLAC__StreamDecoderReadStatus verify_read_callback_(const FLAC__StreamDecoder *decoder, FLAC__byte buffer[], size_t *bytes, void *client_data)
4607|{
4608|	FLAC__StreamEncoder *encoder = (FLAC__StreamEncoder*)client_data;
4609|	const size_t encoded_bytes = encoder->private_->verify.output.bytes;
4610|	(void)decoder;
4611|
4612|	if(encoder->private_->verify.needs_magic_hack) {
4613|		FLAC__ASSERT(*bytes >= FLAC__STREAM_SYNC_LENGTH);
4614|		*bytes = FLAC__STREAM_SYNC_LENGTH;
4615|		memcpy(buffer, FLAC__STREAM_SYNC_STRING, *bytes);
4616|		encoder->private_->verify.needs_magic_hack = false;
4617|	}
4618|	else {
4619|		if(encoded_bytes == 0) {
4620|			/*
4621|			 * If we get here, a FIFO underflow has occurred,
4622|			 * which means there is a bug somewhere.
4623|			 */
4624|			FLAC__ASSERT(0);
4625|			return FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_READ_STATUS_ABORT;
4626|		}
4627|		else if(encoded_bytes < *bytes)
4628|			*bytes = encoded_bytes;
4629|		memcpy(buffer, encoder->private_->verify.output.data, *bytes);
4630|		encoder->private_->verify.output.data += *bytes;
4631|		encoder->private_->verify.output.bytes -= *bytes;
4632|	}
4633|
4634|	return FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_READ_STATUS_CONTINUE;

4637|FLAC__StreamDecoderWriteStatus verify_write_callback_(const FLAC__StreamDecoder *decoder, const FLAC__Frame *frame, const FLAC__int32 * const buffer[], void *client_data)
4638|{
4639|	FLAC__StreamEncoder *encoder = (FLAC__StreamEncoder *)client_data;
4640|	uint32_t channel;
4641|	const uint32_t channels = frame->header.channels;
4642|	const uint32_t blocksize = frame->header.blocksize;
4643|	const uint32_t bytes_per_block = sizeof(FLAC__int32) * blocksize;
4644|
4645|	(void)decoder;
4646|
4647|	if(encoder->protected_->state == FLAC__STREAM_ENCODER_VERIFY_DECODER_ERROR) {
4648|		/* This is set when verify_error_callback_ was called */
4649|		return FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_WRITE_STATUS_ABORT;
4650|	}
4651|
4652|	for(channel = 0; channel < channels; channel++) {
4653|		if(0 != memcmp(buffer[channel], encoder->private_->verify.input_fifo.data[channel], bytes_per_block)) {
4654|			uint32_t i, sample = 0;
4655|			FLAC__int32 expect = 0, got = 0;
4656|
4657|			for(i = 0; i < blocksize; i++) {
4658|				if(buffer[channel][i] != encoder->private_->verify.input_fifo.data[channel][i]) {
4659|					sample = i;
4660|					expect = (FLAC__int32)encoder->private_->verify.input_fifo.data[channel][i];
4661|					got = (FLAC__int32)buffer[channel][i];
4662|					break;
4663|				}
4664|			}
4665|			FLAC__ASSERT(i < blocksize);
4666|			FLAC__ASSERT(frame->header.number_type == FLAC__FRAME_NUMBER_TYPE_SAMPLE_NUMBER);
4667|			encoder->private_->verify.error_stats.absolute_sample = frame->header.number.sample_number + sample;
4668|			encoder->private_->verify.error_stats.frame_number = (uint32_t)(frame->header.number.sample_number / blocksize);
4669|			encoder->private_->verify.error_stats.channel = channel;
4670|			encoder->private_->verify.error_stats.sample = sample;
4671|			encoder->private_->verify.error_stats.expected = expect;
4672|			encoder->private_->verify.error_stats.got = got;
4673|			encoder->protected_->state = FLAC__STREAM_ENCODER_VERIFY_MISMATCH_IN_AUDIO_DATA;
4674|			return FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_WRITE_STATUS_ABORT;
4675|		}
4676|	}
4677|	/* dequeue the frame from the fifo */
4678|	encoder->private_->verify.input_fifo.tail -= blocksize;
4679|	FLAC__ASSERT(encoder->private_->verify.input_fifo.tail <= OVERREAD_);
4680|	for(channel = 0; channel < channels; channel++)
4681|		memmove(&encoder->private_->verify.input_fifo.data[channel][0], &encoder->private_->verify.input_fifo.data[channel][blocksize], encoder->private_->verify.input_fifo.tail * sizeof(encoder->private_->verify.input_fifo.data[0][0]));
4682|	return FLAC__STREAM_DECODER_WRITE_STATUS_CONTINUE;
4683|}

516|/* Number of samples that will be overread to watch for end of stream.  By
517| * 'overread', we mean that the FLAC__stream_encoder_process*() calls will
518| * always try to read blocksize+1 samples before encoding a block, so that
519| * even if the stream has a total sample count that is an integral multiple
520| * of the blocksize, we will still notice when we are encoding the last
521| * block.  This is needed, for example, to correctly set the end-of-stream
522| * marker in Ogg FLAC.
523| *
524| * WATCHOUT: some parts of the code assert that OVERREAD_ == 1 and there's

1469|{
1470|	FLAC__bool error = false;
1471|
1472|	if (encoder == NULL)
1473|		return false;
1474|
1475|	FLAC__ASSERT(0 != encoder->private_);
1476|	FLAC__ASSERT(0 != encoder->protected_);

1479|		if(encoder->protected_->metadata){ // True in case FLAC__stream_encoder_set_metadata was used but init failed

1482|			encoder->protected_->num_metadata_blocks = 0;
1483|		}
1484|		if(0 != encoder->private_->file) {
1485|			if(encoder->private_->file != stdout)
1486|				fclose(encoder->private_->file);
1487|			encoder->private_->file = 0;
1488|		}
1489|		return true;
1490|	}
1491|
1492|	if(encoder->protected_->state == FLAC__STREAM_ENCODER_OK && !encoder->private_->is_being_deleted) {
1493|		if(encoder->private_->current_sample_number != 0) {
1494|			encoder->protected_->blocksize = encoder->private_->current_sample_number;
1495|			if(!resize_buffers_(encoder, encoder->protected_->blocksize)) {
1496|				/* the above function sets the state for us in case of an error */
1497|				return FLAC__STREAM_ENCODER_INIT_STATUS_ENCODER_ERROR;
1498|			}
1499|			if(!process_frame_(encoder, /*is_last_block=*/true))
1500|				error = true;
1501|		}
1502|	}
1503|
1504|	if(encoder->protected_->do_md5)
1505|		FLAC__MD5Final(encoder->private_->streaminfo.data.stream_info.md5sum, &encoder->private_->md5context);
1506|
1507|	if(!encoder->private_->is_being_deleted) {
1508|		if(encoder->protected_->state == FLAC__STREAM_ENCODER_OK) {
1509|			if(encoder->private_->seek_callback) {
1510|#if FLAC__HAS_OGG
1511|				if(encoder->private_->is_ogg)
1512|					update_ogg_metadata_(encoder);
1513|				else
1514|#endif
1515|				update_metadata_(encoder);
1516|
1517|				/* check if an error occurred while updating metadata */
1518|				if(encoder->protected_->state != FLAC__STREAM_ENCODER_OK)
1519|					error = true;
1520|			}
1521|			if(encoder->private_->metadata_callback)
1522|				encoder->private_->metadata_callback(encoder, &encoder->private_->streaminfo, encoder->private_->client_data);
1523|		}
1524|
1525|		if(encoder->protected_->verify && 0 != encoder->private_->verify.decoder && !FLAC__stream_decoder_finish(encoder->private_->verify.decoder)) {
1526|			if(!error)
1527|				encoder->protected_->state = FLAC__STREAM_ENCODER_VERIFY_MISMATCH_IN_AUDIO_DATA;
1528|			error = true;
1529|		}
1530|	}
1531|
1532|	if(0 != encoder->private_->file) {
1533|		if(encoder->private_->file != stdout)
1534|			fclose(encoder->private_->file);
1535|		encoder->private_->file = 0;
1536|	}
1537|
1538|#if FLAC__HAS_OGG
1539|	if(encoder->private_->is_ogg)

1541|#endif

4152|	FLAC__uint64 abs_residual_partition_sums[],
4153|	uint32_t raw_bits_per_partition[],

4177|
4178|	{
4179|		int partition_order;
4180|		uint32_t sum;
4181|
4182|		for(partition_order = (int)max_partition_order, sum = 0; partition_order >= (int)min_partition_order; partition_order--) {
4183|			if(!
4184|				set_partitioned_rice_(
4185|#ifdef EXACT_RICE_BITS_CALCULATION

4187|#endif
4188|					abs_residual_partition_sums+sum,

4190|					residual_samples,
4191|					predictor_order,
4192|					rice_parameter_limit,
4193|					rice_parameter_search_dist,

4210|		}
4211|	}

4214|
4215|	{

4218|		 * knowledge; it is const to the outside world.

4221|		uint32_t partition;

4224|		memcpy(prc->parameters, private_->partitioned_rice_contents_extra[best_parameters_index].parameters, (uint32_t)sizeof(uint32_t)*(1<<(best_partition_order)));

4243|void precompute_partition_info_sums_(
4244|	const FLAC__int32 residual[],
4245|	FLAC__uint64 abs_residual_partition_sums[],
4246|	uint32_t residual_samples,
4247|	uint32_t predictor_order,
4248|	uint32_t min_partition_order,
4249|	uint32_t max_partition_order,
4250|	uint32_t bps
4251|)
4252|{
4253|	const uint32_t default_partition_samples = (residual_samples + predictor_order) >> max_partition_order;
4254|	uint32_t partitions = 1u << max_partition_order;
4255|
4256|	FLAC__ASSERT(default_partition_samples > predictor_order);
4257|
4258|	/* first do max_partition_order */
4259|	{
4260|		const uint32_t threshold = 32 - FLAC__bitmath_ilog2(default_partition_samples);
4261|		uint32_t partition, residual_sample, end = (uint32_t)(-(int)predictor_order);
4262|		/* WATCHOUT: "bps + FLAC__MAX_EXTRA_RESIDUAL_BPS" is the maximum assumed size of the average residual magnitude */
4263|		if(bps + FLAC__MAX_EXTRA_RESIDUAL_BPS < threshold) {
4264|			for(partition = residual_sample = 0; partition < partitions; partition++) {
4265|				FLAC__uint32 abs_residual_partition_sum = 0;
4266|				end += default_partition_samples;
4267|				for( ; residual_sample < end; residual_sample++)
4268|					abs_residual_partition_sum += abs(residual[residual_sample]); /* abs(INT_MIN) is undefined, but if the residual is INT_MIN we have bigger problems */
4269|				abs_residual_partition_sums[partition] = abs_residual_partition_sum;
4270|			}
4271|		}
4272|		else { /* have to pessimistically use 64 bits for accumulator */
4273|			for(partition = residual_sample = 0; partition < partitions; partition++) {
4274|				FLAC__uint64 abs_residual_partition_sum64 = 0;
4275|				end += default_partition_samples;
4276|				for( ; residual_sample < end; residual_sample++)
4277|					abs_residual_partition_sum64 += abs(residual[residual_sample]); /* abs(INT_MIN) is undefined, but if the residual is INT_MIN we have bigger problems */
4278|				abs_residual_partition_sums[partition] = abs_residual_partition_sum64;
4279|			}
4280|		}
4281|	}
4282|
4283|	/* now merge partitions for lower orders */
4284|	{
4285|		uint32_t from_partition = 0, to_partition = partitions;
4286|		int partition_order;
4287|		for(partition_order = (int)max_partition_order - 1; partition_order >= (int)min_partition_order; partition_order--) {
4288|			uint32_t i;
4289|			partitions >>= 1;
4290|			for(i = 0; i < partitions; i++) {
4291|				abs_residual_partition_sums[to_partition++] =
4292|					abs_residual_partition_sums[from_partition  ] +
4293|					abs_residual_partition_sums[from_partition+1];
4294|				from_partition += 2;
4295|			}
4296|		}
4297|	}
4298|}

4300|void precompute_partition_info_escapes_(
4301|	const FLAC__int32 residual[],
4302|	uint32_t raw_bits_per_partition[],
4303|	uint32_t residual_samples,
4304|	uint32_t predictor_order,
4305|	uint32_t min_partition_order,
4306|	uint32_t max_partition_order
4307|)
4308|{
4309|	int partition_order;
4310|	uint32_t from_partition, to_partition = 0;
4311|	const uint32_t blocksize = residual_samples + predictor_order;
4312|
4313|	/* first do max_partition_order */
4314|	for(partition_order = (int)max_partition_order; partition_order >= 0; partition_order--) {
4315|		FLAC__int32 r;
4316|		FLAC__uint32 rmax;
4317|		uint32_t partition, partition_sample, partition_samples, residual_sample;
4318|		const uint32_t partitions = 1u << partition_order;
4319|		const uint32_t default_partition_samples = blocksize >> partition_order;
4320|
4321|		FLAC__ASSERT(default_partition_samples > predictor_order);
4322|
4323|		for(partition = residual_sample = 0; partition < partitions; partition++) {
4324|			partition_samples = default_partition_samples;
4325|			if(partition == 0)
4326|				partition_samples -= predictor_order;
4327|			rmax = 0;
4328|			for(partition_sample = 0; partition_sample < partition_samples; partition_sample++) {
4329|				r = residual[residual_sample++];
4330|				/* OPT: maybe faster: rmax |= r ^ (r>>31) */
4331|				if(r < 0)
4332|					rmax |= ~r;
4333|				else
4334|					rmax |= r;
4335|			}
4336|			/* now we know all residual values are in the range [-rmax-1,rmax] */
4337|			raw_bits_per_partition[partition] = rmax? FLAC__bitmath_ilog2(rmax) + 2 : 1;
4338|		}
4339|		to_partition = partitions;
4340|		break; /*@@@ yuck, should remove the 'for' loop instead */
4341|	}
4342|
4343|	/* now merge partitions for lower orders */
4344|	for(from_partition = 0, --partition_order; partition_order >= (int)min_partition_order; partition_order--) {
4345|		uint32_t m;
4346|		uint32_t i;
4347|		const uint32_t partitions = 1u << partition_order;
4348|		for(i = 0; i < partitions; i++) {
4349|			m = raw_bits_per_partition[from_partition];
4350|			from_partition++;
4351|			raw_bits_per_partition[to_partition] = flac_max(m, raw_bits_per_partition[from_partition]);
4352|			from_partition++;
4353|			to_partition++;
4354|		}
4355|	}

4359|static inline uint32_t count_rice_bits_in_partition_(
4360|	const uint32_t rice_parameter,
4361|	const uint32_t partition_samples,
4362|	const FLAC__int32 *residual
4363|)
4364|{
4365|	uint32_t i;
4366|	uint64_t partition_bits =
4367|		FLAC__ENTROPY_CODING_METHOD_PARTITIONED_RICE_PARAMETER_LEN + /* actually could end up being FLAC__ENTROPY_CODING_METHOD_PARTITIONED_RICE2_PARAMETER_LEN but err on side of 16bps */
4368|		(1+rice_parameter) * partition_samples /* 1 for unary stop bit + rice_parameter for the binary portion */
4369|	;
4370|	for(i = 0; i < partition_samples; i++)
4371|		partition_bits += ( (FLAC__uint32)((residual[i]<<1)^(residual[i]>>31)) >> rice_parameter );
4372|	return (uint32_t)(flac_min(partition_bits,UINT32_MAX)); // To make sure the return value doesn't overflow
4373|}
4374|#else
4375|static inline uint32_t count_rice_bits_in_partition_(
4376|	const uint32_t rice_parameter,
4377|	const uint32_t partition_samples,
4378|	const FLAC__uint64 abs_residual_partition_sum
4379|)
4380|{
4381|	return (uint32_t)(flac_min( // To make sure the return value doesn't overflow
4382|		FLAC__ENTROPY_CODING_METHOD_PARTITIONED_RICE_PARAMETER_LEN + /* actually could end up being FLAC__ENTROPY_CODING_METHOD_PARTITIONED_RICE2_PARAMETER_LEN but err on side of 16bps */
4383|		(1+rice_parameter) * partition_samples + /* 1 for unary stop bit + rice_parameter for the binary portion */
4384|		(
4385|			rice_parameter?
4386|				(abs_residual_partition_sum >> (rice_parameter-1)) /* rice_parameter-1 because the real coder sign-folds instead of using a sign bit */
4387|				: (abs_residual_partition_sum << 1) /* can't shift by negative number, so reverse */
4388|		)
4389|		- (partition_samples >> 1),UINT32_MAX));
4390|		/* -(partition_samples>>1) to subtract out extra contributions to the abs_residual_partition_sum.
4391|		 * The actual number of bits used is closer to the sum(for all i in the partition) of  abs(residual[i])>>(rice_parameter-1)
4392|		 * By using the abs_residual_partition sum, we also add in bits in the LSBs that would normally be shifted out.
4393|		 * So the subtraction term tries to guess how many extra bits were contributed.
4394|		 * If the LSBs are randomly distributed, this should average to 0.5 extra bits per sample.
4395|		 */
4396|	;

4401|#ifdef EXACT_RICE_BITS_CALCULATION
4402|	const FLAC__int32 residual[],
4403|#endif
4404|	const FLAC__uint64 abs_residual_partition_sums[],
4405|	const uint32_t raw_bits_per_partition[],
4406|	const uint32_t residual_samples,
4407|	const uint32_t predictor_order,
4408|	const uint32_t rice_parameter_limit,
4409|	const uint32_t rice_parameter_search_dist,
4410|	const uint32_t partition_order,
4411|	const FLAC__bool search_for_escapes,
4412|	FLAC__EntropyCodingMethod_PartitionedRiceContents *partitioned_rice_contents,

4418|	uint32_t bits_ = FLAC__ENTROPY_CODING_METHOD_TYPE_LEN + FLAC__ENTROPY_CODING_METHOD_PARTITIONED_RICE_ORDER_LEN;

4421|	uint32_t partition_samples, partition_samples_base;

4425|#ifdef ENABLE_RICE_PARAMETER_SEARCH

4434|	raw_bits = partitioned_rice_contents->raw_bits;
4435|
4436|	partition_samples_base = (residual_samples+predictor_order) >> partition_order;
4437|
4438|	/* Integer division is slow. To speed up things, precalculate a fixed point
4439|	 * divisor, as all partitions except the first are the same size. 18 bits
4440|	 * are taken because maximum block size is 65535, max partition size for
4441|	 * partitions other than 0 is 32767 (15 bit), max abs residual is 2^31,
4442|	 * which leaves 18 bit */

4444|
4445|	for(partition = residual_sample = 0; partition < partitions; partition++) {
4446|		partition_samples = partition_samples_base;
4447|		if(partition > 0) {
4448|			partition_samples_fixed_point_divisor = partition_samples_fixed_point_divisor_base;
4449|		}
4450|		else {
4451|			if(partition_samples <= predictor_order)

4453|			else
4454|				partition_samples -= predictor_order;
4455|			partition_samples_fixed_point_divisor = 0x40000 / partition_samples;
4456|		}

4530|{

4532|	FLAC__int32 x = 0;
4533|
4534|	for(i = 0; i < samples && !(x&1); i++)
4535|		x |= signal[i];

4539|	}
4540|	else {

4545|	if(shift > 0) {
4546|		for(i = 0; i < samples; i++)
4547|			 signal[i] >>= shift;

4608|{

4627|		}
4628|		else if(encoded_bytes < *bytes)

4631|		encoder->private_->verify.output.data += *bytes;
